author: reek
body: codex/test/apps/usb-cam-frame proves the isochronous transfer against the driver directly, holding an XhciHost and a UsbDev of its own. This proves the layer above it: `opening` declares Camera and nothing else, and the port reset, the enumeration, the descriptor walk and the TRB all happen behind the effect. Device.Port and Device.Mmio are grounded in Works chapter CamCapture, and if that grounding is wrong this file does not compile.
